info.name: Dueline, offline mode
info.description: Run Dueline with npm run dev:offline, then run the requests in order. Nothing leaves your computer: PayPal and the AI are simulated.

item.name: 1. Sign in with the offline password

exec: pm.test("answers 204 and sets the demo cookie", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 204) throw new Error('Expected 204 but got ' + pm.response.code);
pm.test("answers 200 in offline mode", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(body.offline === true)) throw new Error("Run the app with npm run dev:offline");
if (!(typeof body.today === 'string')) throw new Error("today is a YYYY-MM-DD string");
pm.collectionVariables.set('today', body.today);
pm.test("lists invoices, totals and the balances ready to send", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(Array.isArray(body.invoices) && body.invoices.length > 0)) throw new Error("invoices is a non-empty array");
if (!(typeof body.totals.outstandingInr === 'number')) throw new Error("totals.outstandingInr is a number");
if (!(Array.isArray(body.readyToSend))) throw new Error("readyToSend is an array");
const late = body.invoices.find(function (invoice) { return invoice.dueState === 'overdue' && invoice.paidOn === null; });
if (!(late !== undefined)) throw new Error("the offline story has a late invoice");
pm.collectionVariables.set('lateInvoiceId', late.id);
pm.test("is a PayPal sandbox buyer address", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(body.email.endsWith('@personal.example.com'))) throw new Error("email ends with @personal.example.com");
pm.collectionVariables.set('buyerEmail', body.email);

item.name: 5. Draft an invoice from the sample chat

exec: pm.test("returns a draft with items, warnings and what was masked", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(Array.isArray(body.draft.items) && body.draft.items.length > 0)) throw new Error("draft.items is a non-empty array");
if (!(Array.isArray(body.warnings))) throw new Error("warnings is an array");
if (!(body.masked.emails >= 1)) throw new Error("the client's email was masked before the draft");
if (!(body.draft.currency === 'USD')) throw new Error("the sample chat is in dollars");
pm.collectionVariables.set('draft', JSON.stringify(body.draft));

item.name: 6. Create a deposit and its balance

exec: function addDays(date, days) {
const moved = new Date(date + 'T00:00:00Z');
moved.setUTCDate(moved.getUTCDate() + days);
return moved.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const today = pm.collectionVariables.get('today');
const draft = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('draft'));
draft.client.email = pm.collectionVariables.get('buyerEmail');
pm.variables.set('splitBody', JSON.stringify({
draft: draft,
requestId: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'),
balanceRequestId: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'),
split: { percent: 50, depositDueOn: addDays(today, 7), balanceDueOn: addDays(today, 21) },
pm.test("sends the deposit and saves the balance as a draft", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(body.deposit.sent === true)) throw new Error("the deposit was sent");
if (!(body.balance !== null && typeof body.balance.id === 'string')) throw new Error("the balance was saved");
if (!(body.balance.paypalStatus === 'DRAFT')) throw new Error("the balance is a draft");
pm.collectionVariables.set('balanceId', body.balance.id);
pm.test("sends the balance", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(body.sent === true)) throw new Error("sent is true");
if (!(body.invoice.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('balanceId'))) throw new Error("it is the same balance invoice");

item.name: 8. Note a promised date on a late invoice

exec: function addDays(date, days) {
const moved = new Date(date + 'T00:00:00Z');
moved.setUTCDate(moved.getUTCDate() + days);
return moved.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const promisedOn = addDays(pm.collectionVariables.get('today'), 3);
pm.variables.set('promiseBody', JSON.stringify({ promisedOn: promisedOn, note: 'Client replied on WhatsApp' }));
pm.collectionVariables.set('promisedOn', promisedOn);
pm.test("keeps the date and the note", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(body.promisedOn === pm.collectionVariables.get('promisedOn'))) throw new Error("promisedOn is the date that was sent");
if (!(body.note === 'Client replied on WhatsApp')) throw new Error("the note is kept");
pm.test("answers 204", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 204) throw new Error('Expected 204 but got ' + pm.response.code);
pm.test("lists drafts, heads-ups and the PayPal reminders left today", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(Array.isArray(body.drafts) && Array.isArray(body.headsUps))) throw new Error("drafts and headsUps are arrays");
if (!(typeof body.remindersLeftToday === 'number')) throw new Error("remindersLeftToday is a number");
if (!(body.drafts.every(function (draft) { return draft.message.length > 0; }))) throw new Error("every draft has a message");
const today = pm.collectionVariables.get('today');
const year = Number(today.slice(0, 4));
const month = Number(today.slice(5, 7));
const last = month === 1 ? [year - 1, 12] : [year, month - 1];
pm.collectionVariables.set('lastMonth', last[0] + '-' + String(last[1]).padStart(2, '0'));
pm.test("lists the month's payments with a rupee total", function () {
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Expected 200 but got ' + pm.response.code);
const body = pm.response.json();
if (!(body.month === pm.collectionVariables.get('lastMonth'))) throw new Error("month is the one asked for");
if (!(Array.isArray(body.rows) && Array.isArray(body.outsideRows))) throw new Error("rows and outsideRows are arrays");
if (!(body.totalInr === body.paypalFiraInr + body.bankInr)) throw new Error("totalInr is the two kinds added up");
